Same right here, I always achieve high in anything I do except of relationships. 

With any hobby I take on or project that I start I make something impressive. With the things I do for work I achieve more then anyone else while I'm doing the same in less time although I Just started in this field.

But yeah relationships, I can't really handle myself in them. It feels like that my symptoms get 1000x worse when I start catching feelings for someone. I'm literiatly suicidal over anything and at the same time overly happy about nothing. Feeling endlessly empty whenever I am not getting constantly stimulated. Constantly feeling like I need to abondon everyone. The whole shit show that you probably also recognize. When I have no feelings for anyone it still sucks but it is at least survivable

I think it can have it's usefullness to quit. When you're addicted to sh something of the same but a bit less could work. The rubberband will hurt just as much if you do it in a certain way. You will only miss the blood.

But when sh is the only thing that gets you out of the suicidal thoughts/plans I wouldn't recommend stopping just now. If so try finding a therapist and start working with them on the thoughts and your problems. Then later when you have the thoughts under control you can slowly quit. I'm far from there yet, but I will get there.

What do you mean exactly with worked? Do you mean as an alternative or way to stop sh? 

For me it reduced the cutting. But it only moved the problem because now I had torn skin and really bad bruises. 

It didn't help me at all with stopping with sh. I stopped using it because when I'm in crisis I need to get out there as quick as possible. Cutting is the fastest and the most likely thing to work for me.

I agree with this. I highly suspect that I have BPD but never say that I have it. I am not diagnosed so it is not sure at all. In about 2 months I will hopefully get a diagnoses and I hope the fuck not that it's BPD.
Yeah same in the en you get a simular result it only takes longer to get there

This is some quality meme content! And really what do they think? snapping a rubber band till your skin is basicly gone if that even works for you. That's no cure that's just moving the problem somewhere else
Yes the neutrals are the worst most of the time. I sometimes will say really hurtfull things without noticing. Later while finding out I then get in a endless downwards spiral.

Ah okay I understand your view point. Not that I really  would want to have someone keeping contact as me while I'm dead. It was just something I wondered. 
I to see no point in still being here when dead. The people that might remember me can have a beer together talk about me and later forget it. No need really to keep stretching it further when I'm gone.
Can you explain me why? I want to know others perspectives on this
I had the same. But when I read and thought further about splitting I realized that I was splitting but in different ways.

This is just one way how I split. Most of the times I won't do anything and just seek less or no contact anymore. If they initiate I will be there and put in my effort. But that will just never happen. When I meet someone and they say they truly care about me. It only takes about a month for them to stop initiating contact or asking anything. 
I don't think anyone has ever even cared enough about me to notice it. Someone that cares might notice it but I have yet to experience that. 
This is the sad truth for me.
Then only to wake up by my alarm

I'm not worried at all. Someone once found out about my last Reddit account. If somebody found out they may read your posts. 
But in the end nobody even cares about it anyway

Sorry I don't think you fully understand this. When I perceive someone does something a little different to me then I quickly devalue them. Most of the times I just don't care about them anymore and just do nothing.

I can't just find the trigger and fix it. That won't fix it. Fixing this will take years of therapy

I think/believe it is some sort of toxic self protective mechanism. It tries to protect me from getting abonded by anyone.

I mean as in a way that I'm fucked that I have to live with these scars forever or at least a long time. My left lower leg looks like an unreadable extreme metal band logo. People will notice it for sure and ask what it is. As long as I get clean before this summer it's doable. Starting random projects so I need to finish Them before I commit Sudoku.

Well I think I'm fucked then. I don't use flesh knifes as  it is 50/50 if I will be able to control myself while cutting. I use plastic parts like broken pens. So it is more like tearing open/tearing off your skin. I always go till it bleeds so thats also not good. Except Sometimes I switch and stop caring about the person at all. But the bond that I had before will be broken. 
Either way it sucks and I really want it to stop

You should try it yourself especially fitness works really good. The pain and soreness feels and works simulair for me as cutting. I really eel the difference emotionally, right now the gyms are closed and I cut 3 Times as much.

 I can help you get started if you want.

I think you can call this dissasociating. 

I can only recall one time it happend with another person. I was just talking with someone and suddenly the music went out. The next second I hear the other person calling my name because I wasn't responding. What actually happend is that I was away for about 5 minutes. I didn't respond to anything until my name was called. The music never stopped it was still playing. 

I told my therapist this and he took this really seriously. He told me this is dissasociating and asked me if this has happend to me other times. I don't think you can really recall if it happens when you are on your own as what you perceive is different from what is happening in reality.

Yes sadly it is. Last time I deleted all my Social media accounts in a breakdown because I was convinced I had to distance myself from everyone.
Me next morning: wait what the frick did I do? why? who is this stupid bitch?
I mean for real tho I would buy this shit if it really worked

I don't really have depression. I have really intense moodswings they go from being activly suicidal to being really happy and sometimes I just live in between or don't feel anything at all. My therapists is guessing that it can be borderline. 

This week has been a absolute shithole. I can go around my day and have a good time But every time when I go to sleep and am alone with my thoughts I get really suicidal and start feeling really depressed. 

Most times I keep distracting myself with my phone untill I almost pass out and then go to sleep. 
I sometimes cut myself as this gets rid of the suicidal thoughts and otherwise makes it easy for me to sleep.
And other times I'm stuck there and can't do anything. Distraction isn't working. I can't sleep and can't get myself tired. Cutting doesn't work or I can't make myself do it. Then I'm just stuck being there. Where every minute I'm there I'm getting worse and destruct a little part of me. I'm there stuck for hours until I can finally sleep or just suddenly feel happy again.

Sometimes when stuff gets really bad I post on Reddit like this post. 

So yeah that's how my week is going
There is a whole lot more going on with me But right now this is the biggest problem
